title: tucann's insane fun pack V2
description: My first "big" Minecraft mod made using MCreator (not intended to be taken fully seriously). Requires Geckolib!
body:
![The logo lol](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/456eb3106b79034b8ca424cee4d1fb18a43ec5f9.png)

## This is my first "Big" Minecraft mod, made using MCreator. It adds a bunch of new mobs, weapons, dimensions and gimmicks!

More information can be found in the following YouTube video:

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Uhh1uFOuY0E" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## This mod requires [Geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib)! Be sure to download it as well.


## FEATURES:


## The Zeta Hammer
![The Zeta Hammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a342caa8c0942772987249fff208ffea2831a86f_0.webp)

Crafted using Sculk, Heart of the seas and other elements, this powerful hammer deals 13 damage per hit and can prevent fall damage! It also provides water breathing as long as the player holds it in either hand.

## The Ritual Block
![The Ritual Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1cb226e43fb0fbbd90230fb64fbd90a8448f9a34_0.webp)

This strange block is the first part of the puzzle to take down Facade Flandre in the Delta Dystopia. It severely slows down anyone standing on it, so it can be great to use for traps, mob farms and other components!

## Sculk Wood
![Sculk Wood](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d99f32b5733bdfb1f9bc8472fa510432fce571e_0.webp)

A new type of wood found in the Delta Dystopia. It can help you begin your journey if you start your survival world in the Delta Dystopia! Craft planks, tools, and other useful wood-related items with it!

## Sculk Planks
![Sculk Planks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/71768ec52a233f9fde46a2f03251f717be4497f7_0.webp)

Aside from being a bizarre-looking decoration block, it can provide you with useful equipment as mentioned previously.

## Sculk Leaves
![Sculk Leaves](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/939180f65c65039e8c57da8e96408e979f73f20b_0.webp)

A new type of leaf found in the Delta Dystopia. However, the key to obtaining it was never discovered by the ancient builders. They say only 1 being possesses the knowledge of obtaining this strange collection of leaves, but refuses to elaborate. Instead, this being will offer to trade one for something specific...

## Flandre Fumo
![Flandre Fumo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23e07f5ed62d8b0a84a36a3f444c540534781693_0.webp)

She's so soft and cuddly! She's also the second part of the puzzle to take down Facade Flandre in the Delta Dystopia. when held in your off-hand, she gives you infinite Resistance at level 4!

## Potion of Sun Immunity
![Potion of Sun Immunity](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f12f5c2008dee1986e1d9f0a6ff5462adb7f81b5_0.webp)

A mysterious potion, not brewed through usual means. In order to contain its power, one must encase the essence within a vampiric potion bottle. Instead of drinking it, the essence flows through the bottle and into the fibres of the player, granting them 10 minutes of immunity to sun damage while wearing Flandre Scarlet's Wings.

## Chaos Ore
![Chaos Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85caec724d90324a921df14e3eb210751727f452_0.webp)

This ore contains the power of the 7 Chaos Emeralds, and yet it works in mysterious ways. It shall only offer a portion of its power to those who have completed its previous requirements.

## The Master Emerald
![The Master Emerald](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e6f5042495ed206817319534ace78d046d831b0_0.webp)

The result of forming all 7 Chaos Emeralds together. The wielder must align their Chaos Energy in the form of a specific structure in order to unlock the ability to forge the Emeralds into the Master Emerald. In addition, this wielder must put in 100% of their lifelong experience to attain such an alignment. Once the Master Emerald has been forged, the wielder can harness the power of a Super Transformation, causing them to be immune to all damage as long as they have rings.

## The Nexus Desolator
![The Nexus Desolator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03d82e0285acaf7970e73ff9d2672f417651a5b0_0.webp)

The final boss of this mod's (loose) storyline. A divergent evolution of the Warden, this being seeks nothing but destruction to those that dare summon such a foul beast. Many heroes have tried to slay the Nexus Desolator and obtain the creature's soul, but none have been successful.



More information about the mod and its features, as well as a full walkthrough, can be found in the YouTube video at the top of the page!

If you're the type of player that wants to extend the end goal of "completing" a survival world, and enjoy longer challenges and progression, then this mod is just for you! That is, if you don't take the lore too seriously. Hehe.
